description: This file defines the 'Statement' class for SQLite database interactions within Drupal, implementing custom placeholder handling and execution logic for SQLite statements.

classes.name: Statement
classes.description: A class that extends StatementPrefetchIterator and implements StatementInterface to handle SQLite statement execution with custom placeholder processing.

methods.name: getStatement
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement with custom handling for numeric and named placeholders, replacing placeholders with actual values.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the prepared statement with optional arguments and options, handling schema change errors by re-executing.
